nodes.label: TokenOps architectural sources
nodes.rationale: The implementation adopts run attribution, shared ledger, pre-call enforcement and STEER/HALT while choosing strict Redis admission instead of local eventual consistency.

nodes.label: Atomic budget reservations
nodes.rationale: Every admission uses Redis Lua to check current status, money, tokens and caps before creating the call and increasing shared reserves.

nodes.label: Conditional spending invariant
nodes.rationale: spent + reserved <= budget holds when actual request cost and tokens fit their reservations; provider overruns and Redis data loss are explicit limits.

nodes.label: Integer microdollar accounting
nodes.rationale: Decimal computes prices and integer microdollars enforce money comparisons, with upward rounding once per call and an exact integer STEER threshold.

nodes.label: Idempotent settlement
nodes.rationale: RESERVED or UNKNOWN transitions to SETTLED once; identical deliveries are no-ops and conflicting deliveries are refused.

nodes.label: Lease and heartbeat lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Redis TIME is authoritative, expired leases cannot be revived, and a lease is not the monetary reservation TTL.

nodes.label: Single Redis hash slot
nodes.rationale: Run, calls, events, leases and progress keys share the UUID hash tag so one Lua script can change the complete ledger.

nodes.label: Redis durability boundary
nodes.rationale: ACL/TLS, noeviction, backups and AOF protect the trusted ledger, but asynchronous failover can lose acknowledged admissions and Lua runtime errors do not roll back earlier commands.

nodes.label: UNKNOWN billing state
nodes.rationale: Timeout, cancellation, crash or lease expiry preserve money and token reserves and stop new requests until known usage or operator evidence arrives.

nodes.label: Docker runtime unavailable
nodes.rationale: Compose syntax was checked, but a missing Docker Engine pipe and WSL E_ACCESSDENIED prevented Docker builds, container runs and Linux CI execution.

nodes.label: Redis loss and failover untested
nodes.rationale: The temporary loopback Redis had no persistence; Redis data loss, recovery and Cluster/failover were not tested.

nodes.label: Immutable Checklist Versions
nodes.rationale: Append a complete new checklist version with base_version; preserve the exact criteria used by historical evaluations.

nodes.label: Single-process SQLite Worker
nodes.rationale: One ASGI process holds a file lock, with a bounded worker pool; result commits are once-only but a provider call can repeat after a crash.

nodes.label: Canonical Workspace Projection
nodes.rationale: Canonical stored findings determine the workspace score; browser edits cannot become authoritative evaluations.

nodes.label: Explicit Legacy Database Migration
nodes.rationale: Preserve old databases and export/back up historical records before explicit migration.

nodes.rationale: Synthetic live requests verify infrastructure, schema, evidence and persistence; they do not establish independent semantic accuracy or full-checklist two-pass performance.

nodes.label: Context and Output Safety
nodes.rationale: Reject oversized inputs and truncated outputs rather than scoring incomplete conversations.
